subject: a first try Shiny app:  Center for Medicare and Medicaid (CMS) 2011 DRG hospital charge/pay data

messages.author: 877cd740823aa09d
messages.subject: a first try Shiny app:  Center for Medicare and Medicaid (CMS) 2011 DRG hospital charge/pay data
parts:
Thanks to the tutorial, kind responses from Winston and Joe to a REALLY basic issue about naming folders on the RStudio server, and discussion on this group, I built a simple Shiny app running on the RStudio spark server.

Display is available at http://spark.rstudio.com/iecodesign/DRG_App1/

Here is the gist   https://gist.github.com/klittle314/5784204

To reproduce the display, you need to put this CMS data file in your app directory,

http://www.cms.gov/Research-Statistics-Data-and-Systems/Statistics-Trends-and-Reports/Medicare-Provider-Charge-Data/Inpatient.html

I renamed the file CMSexample.csv from the default download name.

The app allows user to choose one of 100 DRG (Diagnostic Related Group codes, click on the cms link to learn more about the data).  Then the application subsets the master data file by the chosen DRG, further summarizes the data by state, creates a Google map via googleVis tools, creates a small multiples scatter plot array (faceted scatter plot) in ggplot2, and makes the DRG level data set available for download.

For new users like me, the code may help you see details (e.g. need to make explicit the print() command with ggplot2) and save you some time.  I learn best from examples!

I welcome comments on how to make the R code better.

Kevin Little
